name: place_point_based_element
description: Project: place any point-based family instance (furniture, equipment, fixtures, etc.) by FamilySymbol id at a 3D point. Coordinates in millimetres; rotationDeg rotates around Z. levelId omitted = nearest level by elevation. (Routed to /api/project/create_point_based_element; named distinctly from the legacy batch create_point_based_element tool.)
